clue.text: It's risky to extract money and slope off

parts.note: to touch someone is to get money out of them, usually as a loan
to go is to leave, as one who slopes off does

explanation.surface: Someone warns that taking cash and sneaking away is a dangerous business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' is a link before the definition. To touch someone for a fiver is an informal British way of saying to borrow it from them.
explanation.definitionFit: Touch-and-go describes a situation whose outcome is precarious and uncertain, hence chancy.

clue.text: Food for a change of course

definitions.meaning: hard ... is the ship's biscuit sailors ate, so ... means food
in sailing, to ... is to turn the boat's head through the wind on a new course

explanation.definitionFit: Tack is old slang for food, and also a sailing manoeuvre that alters direction.

clue.text: Defenceless, but Cockney's not hurt

indicators.note: a Cockney speaker is famous for dropping the letter H at the start of syllables

parts.note: someone not hurt is left unscathed, without injury

explanation.surface: A Londoner was left without weapons yet came through without injury.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, drop their aitches, so the word for 'not hurt' loses its H.
explanation.definitionFit: Being without weapons leaves a person with no means of defending themselves.

clue.text: Island goddess who combines opposite qualities

parts.note: Herm is one of the smaller Channel Islands, near Guernsey
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love

explanation.surface: A deity from a small island is said to blend contrary traits.
explanation.walkthrough: Herm is a tiny island in the Channel Islands, off Guernsey. The definition reads as 'one who combines opposite qualities', from the creature with both male and female organs.
explanation.definitionFit: A creature with both male and female sexual organs unites opposing characteristics in one body.

clue.text: One whose clothes show little sign of wear

definitions.text: One whose clothes show little sign of wear

parts.words: One whose clothes show little sign of wear
parts.note: seems to describe someone whose garments look new, but means a person whose clothes are hardly ever worn at all

explanation.definitionFit: A naturist goes without garments, so any clothes they own scarcely get worn.

clue.text: One confined to his room for some time

definitions.text: One confined to his room for some time

parts.words: One confined to his room for some time
parts.note: seems to describe an invalid or grounded child, but the room is a cell and the time is a prison sentence

explanation.definitionFit: A convict or habitual prisoner is shut in a cell to serve time.

clue.text: Husband in bar

definitions.meaning: to husband resources is to use them sparingly and conserve them
bar as a preposition means except, as in 'all bar one'

explanation.definitionFit: To economise or conserve is to husband; and 'except' is the sense shared with bar.

clue.text: Spear is first rate when finishing off animal, say

indicators.note: the first-rate piece comes at the close, completing the other letters

parts.note: an ass is a donkey
say means for example, abbreviated eg
A1 (written AI) means first-rate

explanation.surface: A spear is the best thing for killing a beast, it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when finishing off' places the first-rate piece last. The surface reads as killing an animal; 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An assegai is a slender iron-tipped spear used by peoples of southern Africa.

clue.text: Simple way to affluence

parts.note: simple means easy
a street is a way or road

explanation.surface: Someone recommends an uncomplicated route to getting rich.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link. To be 'on easy street' is an idiom for living in comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy street is an idiom for a state of financial comfort and wealth.

clue.text: Pronounced vegetable to be burnt

indicators.note: pronounced says the vegetable's name is heard spoken, not seen written

parts.note: chard is a leafy vegetable, like Swiss chard

explanation.surface: A vegetable is clearly going to be scorched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pronounced' looks like an adjective meaning marked, but it signals a soundalike; 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something scorched black by fire is said to be burnt.

clue.text: These are the players who design one's boots

indicators.note: to design is to work something out anew, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: one is I, and one's gives I'S

explanation.surface: Here are the sportsmen who create footwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' scrambles IS with BOOTS. 'players' suggests footballers with boots, but they are musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: Oboists are musicians who play the oboe, so they are players in an orchestra.

clue.text: Too tolerant of modelling nude revolting!

indicators.note: modelling means shaping, so the following letters are moulded into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone is far too permissive about naked posing, which is disgusting!
explanation.walkthrough: 'modelling' rearranges NUDE and REVOLTING together; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Overindulgent means excessively lenient, too ready to allow and permit.

clue.text: I am decent, but I won't be crossed

parts.note: I am shortens to I'm
decent means passable, good enough

explanation.surface: A person claims to be respectable and refuses to be opposed.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is spoken by, say, a mountain pass or river: something that cannot be traversed would say 'I won't be crossed'.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrier that cannot be traversed would declare that nobody may get over it.

clue.text: Careless talk that may be stepped on

definitions.meaning: the accelerator pedal of a car, as in 'step on it'

explanation.definitionFit: Gas is idle chatter, and in American usage the accelerator pedal one presses to speed up.

clue.text: Strapping appropriate to the sailor type?

definitions.meaning: strapping means big, strong and healthy
an able seaman, the rating abbreviated AB, would fittingly have a physique to match his rank

explanation.definitionFit: Able-bodied means physically fit and strong, and it plays on the rank of able seaman.

clue.text: Knight in retreat had developed into religious leader

indicators.note: retreat means going backwards, so the word is read from the end

parts.note: to knight someone is to dub them

indicators.note: developed suggests something changed in form, so its letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A knight withdrew and then grew into a spiritual figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retreat' reverses DUB to BUD; 'developed' turns HAD into DHA; 'into' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Buddha, Siddhartha Gautama, founded Buddhism and is revered as its spiritual teacher.

clue.text: In Barrie play, appearing brighter

indicators.note: play suggests letters that move about freely and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone looks cleverer in a production of a J M Barrie drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'play' looks like a noun for a Barrie drama but signals the anagram; 'appearing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Brainier means more intelligent, cleverer, as a brighter pupil is.

clue.text: Kind of heel to use such a weapon?

definitions.meaning: a very thin high heel on a woman's shoe
a short dagger with a narrow blade

explanation.definitionFit: A stiletto is a slim high heel and also a thin-bladed dagger; the heel is named after it.

clue.text: Inspect Fang, a canine

parts.note: to eye something is to look it over
a fang is a tooth

explanation.surface: Someone is told to examine the fang of a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canine' looks like a dog; it is the pointed tooth.
explanation.definitionFit: Eye tooth is another name for a canine tooth in the upper jaw.

clue.text: Cut out prunes in quarters

indicators.note: in puts one piece within another

parts.note: two quarters of the compass, east and east again
to prune is to clip, so prunes means clips

explanation.surface: Someone removes dried plums cut into four.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prunes' looks like the fruit but is a verb; E and E are compass points, often called quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: To eclipse something is to outshine it, putting it in the shade, as one cut out.

clue.text: A key weakness in counsel

parts.note: D is a musical key
a vice is a failing or weakness

explanation.surface: A crucial flaw is found in legal representation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link. 'key' looks like an adjective meaning crucial but is a musical key; 'counsel' suggests a barrister.
explanation.definitionFit: Counsel as a noun means guidance, recommendation, the opinion one gives.

clue.text: Cheap version of Gobelin

indicators.note: a version is an altered form, so the word's letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Someone sees a budget copy of a Gobelin tapestry.
explanation.walkthrough: Gobelin is the famous Paris tapestry works; 'Cheap' here means base or dishonourable.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignoble means base or mean-spirited, as a cheap trick is.

clue.text: Take a lot of time to become a member

definitions.meaning: to be lengthy or slow, split as two words
to be part of a group or club

explanation.definitionFit: Split in two the word means to be lengthy; whole, it means to be a member of a group.

clue.text: Essence for application to the palm

definitions.meaning: an essential ... is an extract or essence
palm ..., and also a bribe, as in '... someone's palm'

explanation.definitionFit: An essence is an extracted oil; and greasing a palm means bribery, applying it to the hand.

clue.text: Sickly sensation indicating bad blood

parts.note: sickly means ill
a sensation is a feeling

explanation.surface: Feeling unwell is a sign of disease in the blood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'indicating' is a link; 'bad blood' looks medical but means animosity.
explanation.definitionFit: Bad blood is a common idiom for resentment and hostility between people.

clue.text: Date that is timeless

indicators.note: less says something is removed, here time, abbreviated T

parts.note: id est is the Latin for that is, abbreviated ie

explanation.surface: A date which never ages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'timeless' removes T, the abbreviation for time, from ID EST. The Ides was a date in the Roman calendar, the 15th of some months.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ides was a fixed day in the Roman calendar, the 13th or 15th of the month.

clue.text: Advance of funds had strong effect when announced

indicators.note: announced says the words are spoken out, so we go by the sound

parts.note: something that had a strong effect impressed people

explanation.surface: A loan proved very persuasive once it was made public.
explanation.walkthrough: An imprest is an old term for money advanced, as to a public servant for expenses.
explanation.definitionFit: An imprest is a sum paid in advance, such as a float for official expenses.

clue.text: Finished getting book — I had offered too much

parts.note: finished means over
I had shortens to I'd

explanation.surface: Someone who bought a book at auction regrets paying excessively.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' is a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To overbid is to make a bid higher than the thing is worth, at auction or cards.

clue.text: Regime in legislative assembly

definitions.meaning: a regime is a prescribed course of eating
a parliament, such as the Japanese one or the historical ... of Worms

explanation.definitionFit: A diet is a set eating regimen, and also the name of some national parliaments.

clue.text: Strain leading to tension for coloratura perhaps

indicators.note: the first piece comes before the second, leading it

parts.note: a strain is a tune or song
tension means stress

explanation.surface: Strain causes tension in a singer's delicate vocal passages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strain' looks like stress but is a melody; a coloratura is a soprano with an agile, ornamented voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A coloratura soprano is one example of a female singer.
